title: A San Francisco house worth $4.4 million changed hands through disputed deeds in little over a year
summary_full: In a dramatic legal move, San Francisco authorities have initiated a lawsuit to annul eight contentious deeds associated with a luxurious $4.4 million property in the prestigious Sea Cliff area. This case has been characterized by officials as a complex scheme aimed at seizing control of the estate. After over a year of dubious ownership transitions, the city aims to rectify property records and reaffirm the rightful ownership.
